text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: alert fired — metric latency.slo.p99.eu-west crossing threshold. current p99=1220ms (>SLO 1000ms). window=3/5m. service=inference-gateway-eu.

mike: Acked in PD. I'm oncall, starting triage. :wave:

jess: Copy. Any immediate customer-facing failures?

mike: No big 500 spike, mostly tail latency on chat/generate endpoints. A few slow health-checks.

sarah: I'll bump dedicated pool in eu-west (+2) as a quick mitigation. Kicking now.

mike: Runbook step 1 — check KV prefix cache hitrate and tokenizer coldstarts.

paul: KV hitrate dropped ~12% in last 10m, correlate with a deploy 15m ago. Tokenizer coldstarts minor.

tim: If cache is cold we can run the warm-up job for top prefixes. Command: 
```
/k8s exec warmup --namespace=ops --labels='service=inference' --prefixes-file=/tmp/hot_prefixes.txt
```

jess: Good. Also consider routing a small percentage to the low-latency model-variant as fallback for high-priority traffic.

mike: Doing a canary: route 10% of /v1/generate/chat to model-redwood-latency-v2. Applying router change now.

incident-bot: Update: p99=980ms (after routing & scale) — still in alert window but trending down.

sarah: Warmup finished, top-20 prefix hitrate back to baseline.

paul: Autoscaler added 2 pods as requested, queue length decreased, no OOMs.

jess: Document the temporary fallback and plan rollback in 30m if stable.

mike: Noted. Setting a reminder: `in 30m rollback routing` and adding incident note.

tim: Support reports: a couple of users noticed slowness but no high-sev tickets. Support notified but no escalations.

jess: Customer impact summary: subset of chat traffic saw increased tail latency, no errors or correctness issues. Severity: low.

mike: Escalation avoided. I'll keep monitoring and will hand off at the rotation in ~40m if things stay stable.

tim: I'll take the handoff then. Ping me if anything degrades. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: PagerDuty: alert auto-resolved — p99 below threshold for required windows. Closing alert now.

jess: Post-incident notes: suspected root cause = cache cold after recent deploy + sudden traffic pattern shift. Action items: 1) add KV warmup to deploy job (assign sasha); 2) implement adaptive prefetching for hot prefixes (assign paul); 3) revisit autoscaler thresholds for queue length (assign eng-runtime). Filing follow-up ticket.

mike: Thanks team — handoff to tim complete.

tim: Acknowledged. I'll include the incident summary in the oncall handoff doc and the rotation email. :email:
